test_title: PYST 7: Selection Post (Matric Level) - Quant (Held On 31 Jul, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: maths
question: The average age of 5 members of a family is 20 years. If a new member joins the family, the average age becomes 18 years. What is the age of the new member?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total age of 5 members = 5 × 20 = 100 years

Total age of 6 members = 6 × 18 = 108 years

New member's age = 108 − 100

⇒ 8 years

**∴ The correct answer is 8 years.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Average age of 5 members = 20 years

Average age of 6 members = 18 years

**Formula Used:**

Total Age = Average × Number of Members

 5 Members = 100 6 Members = 108 
• + New Member 108 − 100 = 8 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Total age of 5 members = 5 × 20 = 100 years

⇒ Total age of 6 members = 6 × 18 = 108 years

⇒ Age of new member = 108 − 100

⇒ = 8 years

**∴ The correct answer is 8 years.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Average Formula

Average = Total Sum ÷ Number of Observations.

Adding a New Member

New Value = New Total Sum − Old Total Sum.

Average Decrease Concept

If the average decreases after adding a member, the new member's value is below the original average.
